title: Claude Code
description: Gasto de tokens y coste de Claude: Claude Code (OTLP), API/Console (Admin API) y claude.ai (manual).

links.title: Logs
links.tooltip: Eventos de Claude Code en Loki

panels.title: Real-Time Cost Burn Rate
panels.description: Gasto de Claude Code en los últimos 15 min extrapolado a 1 hora ($/hr). Automático (OTLP).

panels.title: Total Cost Today
panels.description: Coste estimado de Claude Code en las últimas 24 h (claude_code.cost.usage). Verde < $5, amarillo $5-20, rojo > $20.

panels.title: Subagent Cost (24h)
panels.description: Coste de peticiones emitidas por subagentes (query_source="subagent").

panels.title: Main Session Cost (24h)
panels.description: Coste del hilo principal de la sesión (query_source="main").

panels.title: Code Edit Acceptance Rate %
panels.description: Edit/Write/NotebookEdit aceptados sobre el total de decisiones (claude_code.code_edit_tool.decision), 24 h.

targets.expr: 100 * (sum((max_over_time(claude_code_code_edit_tool_decision_total{session_id=~"$session",decision="accept"}[24h]) - (claude_code_code_edit_tool_decision_total{session_id=~"$session",decision="accept"} offset 24h or max_over_time(claude_code_code_edit_tool_decision_total{session_id=~"$session",decision="accept"}[24h]) * 0))) or vector(0)) / clamp_min((sum((max_over_time(claude_code_code_edit_tool_decision_total{session_id=~"$session"}[24h]) - (claude_code_code_edit_tool_decision_total{session_id=~"$session"} offset 24h or max_over_time(claude_code_code_edit_tool_decision_total{session_id=~"$session"}[24h]) * 0))) or vector(0)), 1)

panels.title: Cost Forecast
panels.description: Proyección lineal del burn rate de la última hora: ×24 (día) y ×720 (mes).

panels.title: Average Cost / Session
panels.description: Coste medio por sesión con actividad en las últimas 24 h.

targets.expr: (sum((max_over_time(claude_code_cost_usage_USD_total{model=~"$model",session_id=~"$session"}[24h]) - (claude_code_cost_usage_USD_total{model=~"$model",session_id=~"$session"} offset 24h or max_over_time(claude_code_cost_usage_USD_total{model=~"$model",session_id=~"$session"}[24h]) * 0))) or vector(0)) / clamp_min((count(sum by (session_id) ((max_over_time(claude_code_cost_usage_USD_total{model=~"$model",session_id=~"$session"}[24h]) - (claude_code_cost_usage_USD_total{model=~"$model",session_id=~"$session"} offset 24h or max_over_time(claude_code_cost_usage_USD_total{model=~"$model",session_id=~"$session"}[24h]) * 0))) > 0) or vector(0)), 1)

panels.title: Cost per 1K Tokens
panels.description: Coste por cada 1.000 tokens (incluye cache read/creation), 24 h.

targets.expr: 1000 * (sum((max_over_time(claude_code_cost_usage_USD_total{model=~"$model",session_id=~"$session"}[24h]) - (claude_code_cost_usage_USD_total{model=~"$model",session_id=~"$session"} offset 24h or max_over_time(claude_code_cost_usage_USD_total{model=~"$model",session_id=~"$session"}[24h]) * 0))) or vector(0)) / clamp_min((sum((max_over_time(claude_code_token_usage_tokens_total{model=~"$model",session_id=~"$session"}[24h]) - (claude_code_token_usage_tokens_total{model=~"$model",session_id=~"$session"} offset 24h or max_over_time(claude_code_token_usage_tokens_total{model=~"$model",session_id=~"$session"}[24h]) * 0))) or vector(0)), 1)

panels.title: Active Time (24h)
panels.description: Tiempo activo (usuario + CLI) de claude_code.active_time.total en las últimas 24 h.

panels.title: Token Distribution by Model (24h)
panels.description: Reparto de tokens (input+output+cache) por modelo en 24 h.

panels.title: Active Sessions (24h)
panels.description: Sesiones de Claude Code (session.id) con coste > 0 en las últimas 24 h.

panels.title: Average Session Metrics
panels.description: Media por sesión (24 h): coste, tokens y tiempo activo.

targets.expr: (sum((max_over_time(claude_code_cost_usage_USD_total{model=~"$model",session_id=~"$session"}[24h]) - (claude_code_cost_usage_USD_total{model=~"$model",session_id=~"$session"} offset 24h or max_over_time(claude_code_cost_usage_USD_total{model=~"$model",session_id=~"$session"}[24h]) * 0))) or vector(0)) / clamp_min((count(sum by (session_id) ((max_over_time(claude_code_cost_usage_USD_total{model=~"$model",session_id=~"$session"}[24h]) - (claude_code_cost_usage_USD_total{model=~"$model",session_id=~"$session"} offset 24h or max_over_time(claude_code_cost_usage_USD_total{model=~"$model",session_id=~"$session"}[24h]) * 0))) > 0) or vector(0)), 1)

(sum((max_over_time(claude_code_token_usage_tokens_total{model=~"$model",session_id=~"$session"}[24h]) - (claude_code_token_usage_tokens_total{model=~"$model",session_id=~"$session"} offset 24h or max_over_time(claude_code_token_usage_tokens_total{model=~"$model",session_id=~"$session"}[24h]) * 0))) or vector(0)) / clamp_min((count(sum by (session_id) ((max_over_time(claude_code_cost_usage_USD_total{model=~"$model",session_id=~"$session"}[24h]) - (claude_code_cost_usage_USD_total{model=~"$model",session_id=~"$session"} offset 24h or max_over_time(claude_code_cost_usage_USD_total{model=~"$model",session_id=~"$session"}[24h]) * 0))) > 0) or vector(0)), 1)

(sum((max_over_time(claude_code_active_time_seconds_total{session_id=~"$session"}[24h]) - (claude_code_active_time_seconds_total{session_id=~"$session"} offset 24h or max_over_time(claude_code_active_time_seconds_total{session_id=~"$session"}[24h]) * 0))) or vector(0)) / clamp_min((count(sum by (session_id) ((max_over_time(claude_code_cost_usage_USD_total{model=~"$model",session_id=~"$session"}[24h]) - (claude_code_cost_usage_USD_total{model=~"$model",session_id=~"$session"} offset 24h or max_over_time(claude_code_cost_usage_USD_total{model=~"$model",session_id=~"$session"}[24h]) * 0))) > 0) or vector(0)), 1)

panels.title: Lines of Code Modified
panels.description: Líneas añadidas / eliminadas por Claude Code (claude_code.lines_of_code.count), 24 h.

panels.title: Cache Hit Rate %
panels.description: Tokens de entrada servidos desde caché: cacheRead / (input + cacheRead + cacheCreation), 24 h.

targets.expr: 100 * (sum((max_over_time(claude_code_token_usage_tokens_total{model=~"$model",session_id=~"$session",type="cacheRead"}[24h]) - (claude_code_token_usage_tokens_total{model=~"$model",session_id=~"$session",type="cacheRead"} offset 24h or max_over_time(claude_code_token_usage_tokens_total{model=~"$model",session_id=~"$session",type="cacheRead"}[24h]) * 0))) or vector(0)) / clamp_min((sum((max_over_time(claude_code_token_usage_tokens_total{model=~"$model",session_id=~"$session",type=~"cacheRead|cacheCreation|input"}[24h]) - (claude_code_token_usage_tokens_total{model=~"$model",session_id=~"$session",type=~"cacheRead|cacheCreation|input"} offset 24h or max_over_time(claude_code_token_usage_tokens_total{model=~"$model",session_id=~"$session",type=~"cacheRead|cacheCreation|input"}[24h]) * 0))) or vector(0)), 1)

panels.title: Total Tokens Today
panels.description: Tokens totales (input + output + cache read + cache creation) en las últimas 24 h.

panels.title: Model Token Efficiency (tokens/s)
panels.description: Tokens de salida generados por segundo de procesamiento del CLI (active_time type=cli), última hora.

targets.expr: (sum((max_over_time(claude_code_token_usage_tokens_total{model=~"$model",session_id=~"$session",type="output"}[1h]) - (claude_code_token_usage_tokens_total{model=~"$model",session_id=~"$session",type="output"} offset 1h or max_over_time(claude_code_token_usage_tokens_total{model=~"$model",session_id=~"$session",type="output"}[1h]) * 0))) or vector(0)) / clamp_min((sum((max_over_time(claude_code_active_time_seconds_total{session_id=~"$session",type="cli"}[1h]) - (claude_code_active_time_seconds_total{session_id=~"$session",type="cli"} offset 1h or max_over_time(claude_code_active_time_seconds_total{session_id=~"$session",type="cli"}[1h]) * 0))) or vector(0)), 1)

panels.title: Tool Usage Breakdown
panels.description: Ejecuciones de herramientas (evento claude_code.tool_result, Loki) en 24 h. Las herramientas MCP se agrupan como mcp_tool.

targets.expr: sum by (tool) (count_over_time({service_name="claude-code"} | event_name="tool_result" | session_id=~"$session" | label_format tool=`{{ if hasPrefix "mcp__" .tool_name }}mcp_tool{{ else }}{{ .tool_name }}{{ end }}` [24h]))

panels.title: Peak Cost Hours
panels.description: Coste de Claude Code por hora (barra = hora que empieza en esa marca, incluida la hora en curso), últimas 24 h.

panels.title: Weekly Total Token Usage
panels.description: Tokens totales de Claude Code en los últimos 7 días.

panels.title: Cost Anomaly Detection
panels.description: Desviación del coste/min frente a su media móvil de 1 h. Punto rojo: desviación > 2σ.

panels.title: Prompts Per Hour
panels.description: Prompts enviados en la última hora (evento claude_code.user_prompt, Loki).

panels.title: Tool Decision Sources (24h)
panels.description: Origen de las decisiones de permisos (config, hook, user_permanent, user_temporary, user_abort, user_reject).

panels.title: Spend by Surface (24h)
panels.description: Claude Code: coste estimado OTLP (24 h). API/Console: cost_report de la Admin API (día UTC). claude.ai: precio del plan prorrateado por día (manual, CLAUDE_AI_PLAN_MONTHLY_USD).

panels.title: Spend Share by Surface
panels.description: Peso relativo del gasto por superficie (claude.ai es prorrateo manual).

panels.title: claude.ai Weekly Limit % (manual)
panels.description: Manual: % del límite semanal de claude.ai (web / móvil) registrado con log-usage.sh o el formulario. Naranja ≥ 70 %, rojo ≥ 90 %.

panels.title: claude.ai Usage % (manual)
panels.description: Manual: evolución del % de uso de claude.ai por superficie y ventana (weekly / session).

panels.title: API Cost per Day
panels.description: Admin API cost_report (bucket 1d), apilado por modelo. Se actualiza cada 5 min. Vacío si ANTHROPIC_ADMIN_KEY no está configurada.

panels.title: API Cost by Model (31d)
panels.description: Admin API cost_report: coste acumulado por modelo en la ventana de LOOKBACK_DAYS.

panels.title: Tokens by Type
panels.description: Tokens de Claude Code por tipo (input, output, cache read, cache creation), apilados por intervalo.

panels.title: API Tokens Today by API Key / Workspace
panels.description: Admin API usage_report: tokens del día UTC por api_key, workspace, modelo y tipo.
